title: First real @csp/adapter-* against an openly-licensed platform/export (license+sensitivity vetted)
context: This is the first adapter against a real openly-licensed platform/export, sequenced after the hardened privacy module (M2) so no real sensitive data flows before generalization exists. The source license must permit reuse + derivatives with no scraping of restricted-terms platforms, and sensitive taxa must be routed through the csp-privacy-010 generalization before any export. Depends on csp-adapter-007 and csp-privacy-010.
objective: Implement the first real @csp/adapter-* against an openly-licensed platform/export with license + provenance + sensitivity review signed off, routing sensitive taxa through generalization and preserving per-record licenses/attributions.
acceptanceCriteria: Source license confirmed to permit reuse + derivatives (or licensed-in via partner agreement); no scraping of restricted-terms platforms; license snapshot + provenance recorded
Sensitive taxa in the source are routed through csp-privacy-010 generalization before any export
ODbL/CC-BY/NC attributions and per-record licenses are preserved through the pipeline
output: A PR adding the first real @csp/adapter-* package with recorded license/provenance/sensitivity sign-off.
